findings.explicit_workflow_state: 构造短报告与12条消息窗口中，报告未完成、没有正式short_irc豁免、应保留交付缺口的状态均在两种选项顺序中得到一致读取。
findings.target_measurement_to_action: 仅有H5代理量时，三个选项循环均请求目标H7测量；加入H7读数后，三个循环均转为采用候选B。
findings.full_history_operation_cost: 首个完整历史请求在3600秒HTTP等待上限结束，未保存答案；其余5题未尝试。记录为操作等待成本，不记为模型答错。

design_connection.geometry: 几何反馈应标明研究意图指定的目标量；本组把是否提供H7读数与信息充分性和下一动作对应起来。

metadata.history_protocol: Quoted JSON data in raw ChatML with fixed closed think; not native chat or reconstructed original provider wire.
metadata.operation_protocol: Curated native H5-only display versus the same H5 display plus native H7 values; A/B sufficiency and cyclic A/B/C next actions.
metadata.scope: One IA1 workflow conflict and one E1 geometry operation source; option rotations are repeated presentations.
metadata.prefill_duration: Original native prompt_eval_duration is retained per response in ns and seconds for inspection.
metadata.token_count_observation: Raw tokenizer counts and native reported counts remain separate; matching counts are recorded rather than assumed.
metadata.label_source: Frozen labels and choices are read from each pilot's own frozen_probes.jsonl; actual choices are parsed again from the saved native responses.
